CM Yogi Adityanath attacks SP-Congress over Lord Ram

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attacked the Samajwadi Party (SP) and Congress, stating that his government worships those whom the opposition never acknowledged. He made these remarks while announcing the formation of a nomadic development board. Adityanath specifically invoked Lord Ram in his criticism of the opposition parties.
